PancakeSwapV2_ETH_COW.$comment: Cake-LP for Binance-Peg ETH (0x2170...) / CoW Protocol Token (0x5BfdAa...). Test holder 0x616dE58c011F8736fa20c7Ae5352F7f6FB9F0669 is the genesis LP. Disabled by default: COW has no Chainlink feed on BSC, so registering it would require a custom price feed first. Until that lands, NAVCalculator's per-asset registry filter would silently drop the COW leg of any PCS V2 ETH/COW LP and value the position only on its ETH side — i.e. understate it by ~half. PERMANENT, not pending: COW has no price feed on ANY chain and none is planned, so do NOT flip enabled to true expecting one to arrive — the only route would be replacing this entry with a different pair whose tokens are all priced. THIS COMMENT IS THE DECLARATION SITE FOR BSC. Every other chain declares its unpriceable tokens in test/integration/accounts.json under chains.<id>.$untracked_by_design, but chain 56 is not in accounts.json at all (it covers 1, 10, 100, 8453, 42161), so BSC produces no comparison-report rows and there is nowhere else to record this. See the identical mainnet (UniswapV3_WETH_COW_3000) and Base (PancakeSwapV3_WETH_COW) entries.
